name: deviation-kernel
description: Holds a project's refused assumptions in Claude's system prompt, flags edits and answers that re-impose them, and pauses on the step where it happens

mode.title: On a tripped refusal in an edit
mode.description: ask: hold the edit and ask you. warn: let it through and flag it to Claude. block: refuse the edit.

semanticCheck.title: Semantic drift check
semanticCheck.description: After each answer, a small model reads it against the kernel and flags conventional fillers the keyword tells miss.
